title: Fourteen Springs and One Short Word
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：empathy　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 empathy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 my teacher ① showed an empathy that no pupil in the class would have named, and he said the showing was the whole of the spring. The ② empathy, meaning the understanding and not the pity, ran fourteen springs and stayed unnamed in the book; an empathy, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ empathy in that class had the same short word at the end of it, and the ④ empathy at the end, meaning the one they kept for the new pupils and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An empathy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my teacher said the naming is the part that fills fourteen springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the empathy was the whole of the story, meaning the pity and not the understanding. The ⑥ empathy, meaning the pity and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody offers and nobody asks for; empathy, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both an understanding and a pity. He said the pity is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ empathy had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short word. The ⑧ empathy of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in April, was one class and fourteen springs of naming; empathy, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ empathy I remember is the one named in the notebook, which faded in 2009 and is still described as the quietest in the class. An ⑩ empathy, my mother said in 2011, is the only one that improves by being named; every empathy, she said, is a pity that has agreed to look like an understanding. She said the pity was the honest half.

empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，指那份共情本身而不是同情，它经过了十四个春天而在簿子上没有名字。
empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，指那个班上的每一份共情，每一份到头都有同一句短短的话。
empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，指留给新同学的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
empathy 意为“同情、怜悯”，指故事里人人都给却无人开口要的那样东西，叔叔说这份同情就是那个故事的全部。
empathy 意为“同情”，指人人都给却无人开口要的那种东西而不是那份共情，是故事里人人都给、却无人开口要的东西。
empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，指笔记里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1997 年这份共情成了笔记里的一行。
empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，老师四月写道，整件事的体谅之事是一个班级和十四个春天的命名。
empathy 意为“共情、同理心”，我记得的是笔记里记下的那一份，2009 年淡去了，至今仍被说成班里最安静的一份。
empathy 为抽象总称，母亲 2011 年说，一份共情是唯一会因为被好好命名而变得更好的东西。
